title: D-SP-4 Stage 2c: live progress for watched tool calls (mission phase lines as MCP notifications/progress)
goal: A tools/call that carries a progressToken gets the tool's own progress lines as notifications/progress between the started (0.0) and finished (1.0) ones, coalesced to about 10 a second. Lines cross plane-bus hops on a bus stream (tools plane, GAWD plane). The mission reports phase lines (started, planning or answering, swarm running and finished, verifying, completion); unwatched calls and the CLI are unchanged.
